# Code of conduct

HaanJi follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short:
- Be respectful in issues, pull requests and reviews.
- Discuss the work, not the person.
- No harassment, no insults, and no publishing anyone's private details. That includes the phone numbers and names in call data.

If someone breaks this, tell the maintainers privately through
**Security → Report a vulnerability** on this repository. Use the same channel
when the problem is about a person rather than a bug. The maintainers may
remove comments, close threads or block an account.
